/.title: Bi’ Plan — İstanbul’da sana göre bir şey var

conclusion: The tracked UI and Vinext route bundle can build and start as a Node standalone server suitable for a container entrypoint. Storage-backed application behavior is not portable until D1 and R2 adapters are implemented.
limitations: This is local framework compatibility evidence, not Cloud Run deployment, performance, billing, or production-readiness evidence.
No D1-compatible database adapter, R2-compatible checkpoint adapter, cloud secrets, provider calls, catalog, or recommendation request was exercised.
Cloud Run can use a remote SQLite-compatible service such as Turso or another database; this spike does not select or validate a database product.
No cloud API, network dependency installation, Docker daemon, or global configuration was used.
